language_approval.notes: H60 gate: all 6 beats read; witty (= clever, not very funny) -> side-splitting comedy; comical (= funny in a silly/odd way) -> laugh-out-loud cartoon; hysterical example -> 'a hysterical cat video' (movie scene read as a scene of hysteria); hilarious, priceless (informal 'extremely funny', Oxford) kept; hook and structure untouched; caps OK; espeak phonemes checked
